description: Registers an http or https URL for the events site.published, site.version_restored, site.deleted, site.taken_down, domain.active, and report.received. Inputs: url, optional events, and token. Returns the webhook id and an HMAC secret once. Free allows 1 webhook, Hobby 5, Pro 20. Private, internal, and localhost targets are rejected. Delivery is best-effort, with up to 3 attempts. API documentation: https://deed.page/docs.

events.description: Events to send. Omit for all of them.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

url.description: Public http or https URL on port 80 or 443.

name: create_webhook
title: Register a webhook
